assign.outcome:
**Every page has a menu button (☰) in its top right; it opens the drawer on five tabs: AI, Sessions, Dictation, Settings, Admin.** The open tab is in the url (`?drawer=sessions`), so a reload lands on it.

![The drawer open on its AI tab](/framework/ext/drawer/doc/tabs.png)

- The AI tab reuses the card's composer. On a card it talks into the card; on a page, `send()` tries the page assistant and falls back to Ask today.
- Sessions lists this page's saved Ask threads. Click one and the next message carries it on, even when the old session is gone.
- Proof, one line per deliverable: [proof.md](/framework/ai/2026-09-28/page-drawer/m1/proof.md) · how it works: [doc/tabs](/framework/ext/drawer/doc/tabs/) · try it: [the drawer page](/framework/ext/drawer/)
